text:
nina: quick preflight for a quiet entitlement sweep in infra-prod. scope: ownerless admin-like bindings + overly permissive KMS key policies. small canary, revertable.

arpit: sounds good. suggestion: snapshot + dry-run -> single-binding removal/day -> 2hr watch window.

faye: add checks: last_used > 90d for service accounts, cloudtrail decrypt events for keys.

audit-bot: scan results: 9 candidate bindings, 4 keys with wildcard principals. details uploaded to s3://security-audit/5423456789/dryrun.json

nina: action items:
- arpit: produce audit snapshot + dry-run script (due today)
- faye: create smoke test checklist and monitoring hooks (due tomorrow)
- oncall-ops: standby for paging during windows

oncall-ops: will be oncall. ping 30m before any removal.

arpit: will include rollback script that reapplies snapshot and an artifact checksum.

faye: prefer PR-for-readd if infra automation reintroduces removed bindings. short exceptions only via ticket.

audit-bot: runbook reference: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/entitlement-sweep (contains rollback snippets).

nina: thanks — will post dry-run link and schedule the canary once artifacts are ready. keep updates brief in this thread. :lock:
